title: 10 Most Active Penny Stocks to Buy - Insider Monkey
summary: The article discusses the impact of the 2026 Iran conflict on market volatility, with significant declines in the S&P 500 and international equities, alongside a surge in oil prices. Despite this, there is a historical precedent for market recovery within a month after geopolitical events. The latter part of the article shifts focus to the most active penny stocks, highlighting increased trading activity and institutional interest.
sentiment_reason: The article primarily discusses negative market impacts such as increased volatility, declines in major indices, and rising inflation concerns, but also includes a note on historical market recoveries and positive analyst ratings on certain penny stocks.
